description:
Record a payment for an invoice on PayPal.

This function records an external or manual payment (for example, cash, check, bank transfer, or a PayPal transaction) against an invoice, by invoice ID. If the recorded amount covers the full amount due, PayPal marks the invoice PAID; otherwise it is marked PARTIALLY_PAID. This does not process a new payment -- it only logs one that was already collected.

method is required. payment_id applies only to PAYPAL-type payments.

Checked by fizzl-paypal-guard before it runs: the owner approves or denies each one.

inputSchema.description: Record an external or PayPal payment against an invoice.

amount.description: The currency and amount for a financial transaction.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

invoice_id.description: The ID of the invoice to record the payment against.

method.description: The payment mode or method through which the invoicer can accept the payments.

note.description: A note associated with an external cash or check payment.

payment_date.description: The date when the invoicer recorded the payment, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

payment_date_time.description: The date and time when the invoicer recorded the payment, in Internet date and time format (ISO 8601), for example 2018-05-13T21:20:00Z or 2018-05-13T21:20:00.000-08:00. Seconds are required.

payment_id.description: The ID for a PayPal payment transaction. Required for the PAYPAL payment type.

shipping_info.description: The shipping information associated with this payment.

address_line_1.description: The first line of the address, for example, number and street.

address_line_2.description: The second line of the address, for example, suite or apartment number.

admin_area_1.description: The highest-level sub-division in a country, such as a state or province.

country_code.description: The two-character ISO 3166-1 country code (for example, US or GB).

postal_code.description: The postal code, which is the zip code or equivalent.

business_name.description: The business name for the shipping destination.

name.description: The name for the shipping destination.

given_name.description: The first name of the person.

surname.description: The last name of the person.

name: record_payment_for_invoice
